android.text: Updates local reading-state storage. Upgrading preserves existing reading data; returning to an older app requires restoring a full pre-update app-data copy taken while the app is closed. Library backups omit reading-state records.

desktop.text: Updates local reading-state storage. Upgrading preserves the library; returning to an older desktop build requires restoring a full pre-update data-directory copy taken while the reader is closed.
